# Draft:Robert King (South African activist)

Robert Christian King is a South African political activist associated with the Cape independence movement. He is a member of the Referendum Party, serves as the party’s economy spokesperson and Secretary General, and is a co-founder and former president of the Cape Youth Front. He is also a member of the executive committee of the Cape Independence Advocacy Group. In the 2024 South African general election, he was the Referendum Party’s number-one candidate on the national, regional and provincial lists, making him one of the youngest candidates in the election and the youngest party list leader in the country at 20 years old. King describes himself as a political activist campaigning for Cape independence and other forms of self-determination in South Africa. His role in the movement has attracted national media attention and criticism from commentators opposed to Cape independence.
